title: T-Rex Dino
description: Guide the pixel T-Rex across the desert and jump over cactus after cactus as the pace keeps rising in this free endless runner for your browser.
about:
T-Rex Dino is the classic pixel-art endless runner: a little dinosaur sprints across a black-and-white desert while cacti of every size come rushing toward it. One well-timed jump keeps the run alive, one mistimed jump ends it.

The game stretches to fit any screen, from a wide monitor to a phone held sideways. The simple rules hide a real challenge. The dinosaur keeps getting faster, cacti arrive alone or in wide clusters, and a short tap gives a lower hop than a long press, so you need to read each obstacle and adjust. Every 100 points the score counter flashes to celebrate your progress, and your best score is saved in the browser and shown as HI next to the current one.

It is ideal for a few minutes of pure reflex play, on a computer with the keyboard or on a phone with a single finger.
howToPlay: Press Space, the Up arrow, click or tap to make the T-Rex jump; the first jump starts the run. Hold longer for a higher jump, and press the Down arrow or swipe down in mid-air to drop faster. Your score grows with the distance you cover, and the run ends as soon as you hit a cactus. After a crash, tap, click or press Space or Enter to run again.

controls.action: Jump (hold for a higher jump), or restart after a crash
Drop faster while in the air

tips: Use short taps for single small cacti and hold the jump for wide groups.
Jump a little earlier as the game speeds up, since the dinosaur covers more ground in the air.
Press Down right after clearing a cactus to land sooner and be ready for the next one.
Keep your eyes on the right side of the screen so you see obstacles coming early.

faq.question: Is T-Rex Dino free to play?
faq.answer: Yes. T-Rex Dino is completely free and runs in your browser with no download or account.

faq.question: Can I play T-Rex Dino on a phone or tablet?
faq.answer: Yes. The game fills the screen in any orientation: tap anywhere to jump, hold for a higher jump, swipe down to drop faster and tap again after a crash to restart. Holding the phone sideways gives the biggest view.

faq.question: Is my high score saved?
faq.answer: Yes. Your best score is saved in this browser and shown as HI next to your current score, even after you close the page.

faq.question: What happens if I switch tabs during a run?
faq.answer: The game pauses automatically. Tap, click or press Space when you come back to carry on from where you left off.
